adds.title: Missouri Save Adolescents from Experimentation (SAFE) Act
adds.summary: On June 7, 2023, Missouri enacted S.B. 49 effective August 28 banning gender-affirming treatments including puberty blockers for minors until August 2027 with license loss for violating providers while allowing minors already receiving care to continue, and S.B. 39 requiring public and private schools through college to restrict sports participation to sex assigned at birth.
